rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural edit instead of another scalar sweep. The tail recurrence now learns a per-block anchor-refresh mix that progressively updates the decoder-output anchor after each reverse recurrence pass, aiming to keep the carry target aligned with the refined tail state while preserving fixed shapes, the same final exact int8+zlib evaluation path, and the existing export-aware endgame.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor EMA Refresh
